title: Turn a needle into a 10 V voltmeter
story: You found an old moving-coil movement: its needle reaches full scale at 1 mA and its coil has 200 ohm. Connected to a 10 V test source, it should read (at or just below) full scale, never past it. Pick the multiplier resistor.

goals.label: needle does not go past full scale (1 mA)
needle reaches at least 95 % of full scale

hints: At full range, 10 V must push 1 mA through the multiplier and the coil in series.
Total resistance = 10 V / 1 mA = 10 000 ohm. The coil already provides 200 ohm.
The exact answer, 9800 ohm, is not in the bin. A bit more resistance reads slightly low; a bit less pins the needle.
